description: Add a --stale flag to `mementic list` that filters to items not modified in 30+ days. The flag should work with all existing list subtypes (decisions, constraints, entities). When --stale is passed, only show items where the last_modified timestamp (or equivalent) is older than 30 days from now.
architectural_context_needed: graph schema: how timestamps are stored on nodes
CLI conventions: Typer command pattern for adding flags
list command internals: how filtering works currently
model classes: how items track modification time

description: Add a new deterministic lint rule 'duplicate-constraint' that detects two active MUST constraints on the same entity with semantically similar descriptions. Two constraints conflict if they share a bound entity and their descriptions differ. Use the existing lint rule pattern in mementic/lint.py.
success_command: uv run pytest -xvs tests/ -k lint && uv run ruff check mementic/lint.py
architectural_context_needed: lint rule pattern: how rules are structured in lint.py
constraint model: how constraints link to entities
severity system: how severity levels are assigned
graph API: how to traverse entity-constraint edges

description: Add a `mementic export` CLI command that exports the current project's graph to a JSON file. The output should include all active decisions, constraints, and entities with their relationships (edges). Use --output (or -o) to specify the output file path. Follow existing CLI patterns in mementic/cli.py.
architectural_context_needed: graph storage format: SQLite schema and how nodes/edges are stored
CLI conventions: Typer command pattern, --output flag naming
JSON serialization: how graph data is converted to JSON elsewhere
file I/O conventions: where output goes by default
